name: Summon nature Spirit
description: (Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Summon a nature spirit, requiring sufficient fertile ground nearby, such as nature Spirits, Dryads, Giant Animated Plants, Treants, Dendroid Soldiers, etc. Limited to Rare familiar power or less; strength depends on your power. It draws on your energy to stay manifested and use abilities, unsummoning if unfueled, but with proper skills, time, and energy you can make it permanent.
